description:
The Addison 6 Drawer Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides for onesies, sleepers, blankets, and more, in a solid hardwood frame.

It measures 56 inches wide, 35 inches high, and 21 inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete Addison collection.
title: Addison 6 Drawer Dresser
